detailed_description: The Pinyin Converter turns pasted text into pinyin output in the browser using the local toPinyin helper. You can enter text in a textarea, choose whether to include tones with a single checkbox, click Convert, clear the input and output, and copy the converted result. The tool is intended for quick browser-side conversion and does not provide separate tone-style dropdowns, word segmentation controls, case formatting options, file downloads, ISO compliance guarantees, statistical language models, or advanced ambiguity resolution.
usage_steps: Paste text into the input textarea.
Use the With Tone checkbox to choose tone output when needed.
Click Convert to generate pinyin output.
Copy the output from the result textarea or clear the tool.
usage_examples: Convert a short Chinese phrase to pinyin while studying pronunciation.
Compare output with tones enabled or disabled for a quick note.
Copy converted pinyin into a flashcard draft or vocabulary list.
Clear the textarea and test another small sample.
